prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your organization’s size, goals, budget, services needed, and culture fit. I can help you find the best match. To do that well, I’ll need a few details — or I can give you a short list of steps and evaluation criteria so you can quickly vet candidates yourself.

Quick questions to narrow the search
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, specialty clinic, dental, urgent care, private practice, medical device, health tech/startup)
- Main goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, physician referrals, digital transformation, content/PR, recruitment)?
- Services you need (web design, SEO, paid media, social, CRM/marketing automation, creative/branding, content strategy, telehealth marketing, HIPAA-compliant comms)?
- Monthly/annual marketing budget range?
- Timeline for results (ongoing vs campaign-based)?
- Any must-haves (HIPAA experience, local community relationships, B2B vs B2C, Spanish-language services)?

How to identify the “best” agency for your situation
- Relevant healthcare experience: case studies with measurable results for similar-sized clients or similar services (e.g., increased new patient volume, cost-per-lead improvements, referral growth).
- Compliance & privacy: familiarity with HIPAA and state rules; processes for handling PHI in marketing systems.
- Data & analytics: clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and examples of ROI tracking.
- Creative + technical balance: strong creative work plus technical capabilities (SEO, analytics, paid media, martech integrations).
- Local market knowledge: network and reputation in St. Louis can help with partnerships, PR, and referral relationships.
- Transparency & processes: clear scopes, timelines, pricing model, and examples of typical deliverables.
- Client retention & references: long-term clients and contactable references you can call.

Checklist of questions to ask agencies
- Can you show 2–3 healthcare case studies with results and references?
- How do you handle HIPAA and PHI in marketing campaigns and systems?
- Who would be on our account team and how much time would they dedicate?
- What KPIs would you recommend and how often do you report?
- What is your typical onboarding process and timeline?
- Do you have experience with our specific patient demographics, specialties, or referral networks?
- Can you provide a sample contract and pricing model (retainer, project-based, performance-based)?

Where to look for St. Louis agencies
- Local searches: Google, Google Maps, and LinkedIn (search for “healthcare marketing agency St. Louis”).
- Industry directories: Clutch.co, UpCity, Agency Spotter — filter for healthcare.
- Local business groups: St. Louis Regional Chamber, healthcare associations, hospital supplier lists.
- Referrals: peers at similar practices/hospitals or vendors (EHR/PM companies often know agencies).

Typical budget ranges (rough guide)
- Small practice / single clinic: $2,000–$8,000/month
- Multi-location clinic or specialty group: $8,000–$25,000/month
- Large hospital systems or enterprise: $25,000+/month (often a mix of internal team + agency partners)

If you want, I can:
- Build a curated shortlist of 4–6 St. Louis healthcare marketing agencies with strong qualifications and recent case studies (I can include contact details and a recommended fit).
- Draft a customized RFP or email you can send to agencies.
- Compare 2–3 agencies you’re already considering.

Which option would you like? If you want a shortlist, tell me the type of organization, your budget range, and top 2–3 priorities.
